info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Enterprise Tax Administration API
info.description: The Enterprise Tax Administration API provides financial institutions with the capability to update and manage tax-related information for enterprises. By utilizing this PATCH operation, consumers can efficiently modify specific attributes related to enterprise taxes, ensuring compliance and accuracy in financial reporting. This API is especially beneficial for accountants, tax consultants, and financial departments seeking to streamline tax management processes. With this functionality, users can keep their tax information up-to-date, reflecting any changes in regulations or business circumstances.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific enterprise tax administration record identified by its unique resource ID (RES-100045). Make sure to provide the required fields in the request body for a successful update.

requestBody.description: This request body allows you to update the tax administration details for a specific enterprise identified by RES-100045. It requires a valid JSON object that conforms to the specified schema.

200.description: The request was successful, and the resource has been updated.
